overall: Okay so, honestly? This is way more fun than a normal personality quiz, and a bunch of these cards know my actual life: the $200 jacket going to a bill, the banner with $30 fun money, the 11:48pm third-night text, 'said ten minutes, left three hours later', and the circumstance exits that let me say 'I can't, I'm broke' without it counting against me. That's the part I'd tell friends about. My big flag is the money layer. In a few places being broke gets read as a personality: saying a plan is over my budget gives me 'Limited-edition energy', knowing my balance makes me 'There's a spreadsheet for that', picking the $10 plant makes me 'Booked solid, all me', buying dupes makes me a minimalist, and a $40 Valentine's makes me 'own script'. People like me will get tags that are really our bank account, and those are exactly the results we'd screenshot and say 'this is wrong'. Fix the tags on those options and add 'not having the money' to the never lines.
